title: Pakistan Navy ship in Bangladesh after over 50 years
description: A Pakistan Navy ship visited Bangladesh's Chattogram Port last Friday. This marks the first such visit since 1971. The move follows a significant improvement in bilateral relations. Analysts suggest Pakistan is seeking to increase its presence in the Bay of Bengal. This development carries security implications for eastern India and Myanmar.

title: Munir's constitutional coup, a tweak in Zia-ul-Haq's playbook
description: Pakistan's Army Chief Asim Munir is consolidating power through a constitutional amendment. This move grants him lifetime immunity and control over nuclear assets. The amendment bypasses existing structures, effectively creating a military-led government. India must increase its vigilance as this development unfolds. The situation mirrors past military takeovers in Pakistan.
